# Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyr, dplyr, ggplot2, lubridate, tibble, stringr,
               knitr, kableExtra, broom, fixest, lme4, nlme, clubSandwich, here)
```

# Import ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

load("../data/processed/model2_data.RData")

# Log-transform outcome, restrict to German NUTS-3 regions
model2_data_extended <- model2_data %>%
  mutate(log_active_per_100k = log(active_per_100k)) %>%
  filter(str_starts(NUTS3, "DE"))
```

# Figure: RPS partner density over time -----------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: fig-plot-mean
#| fig-cap: "**RPS partner density rose at mandate implementation and subsequently declined across all urbanization levels.** Mean active RPS partners per 100,000 inhabitants per month for German NUTS-3 regions stratified by urbanization level and Austrian control regions. Lines represent group means; grey shaded area indicates the anticipation period (October-December 2022); vertical dashed line marks mandate implementation (January 2023). n = 394 German regions; n = 6 Austrian control regions."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-asp: 0.65
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| out-width: "90%"
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

df_plot_mean <- model2_data %>%
  filter(month >= as.Date("2021-09-01"),
         month <= as.Date("2024-12-01")) %>%
  group_by(country, lage_typ, month) %>%
  summarise(
    active_per_100k = mean(active_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(color_group = ifelse(country == "AT", "AT", lage_typ))

# ColorBrewer Blues for DE urbanization levels + Okabe-Ito vermillion for AT
colors <- c(
  "metropolitan" = "#c6dbef",
  "very central" = "#9ecae1",
  "central"      = "#6baed6",
  "rural"        = "#2171b5",
  "very rural"   = "#084594",
  "AT"           = "#D55E00"
)

ggplot(df_plot_mean, aes(x = month, y = active_per_100k,
                         group = color_group, color = color_group)) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = as.Date("2022-11-01"), xmax = as.Date("2023-01-01"),
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("text",
           x = as.Date("2022-08-01") + 5, y = Inf,
           label = "Anticipation",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2,
           color = "grey20", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2023-01-01"),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colors,
    name   = "Location type / country",
    breaks = c("metropolitan", "very central", "central", "rural", "very rural", "AT"),
    labels = c("Metropolitan (DE)", "Very central (DE)", "Central (DE)",
               "Rural (DE)", "Very rural (DE)", "Austria (AT)")
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Average active partners per 100,000 inhabitants") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Preprocess: Add ITSA time variables -------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

model2_data_extended <- model2_data_extended %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(
    time       = lubridate::interval(as.Date("2021-03-01"), month) %/% months(1),
    month_name = factor(month(month, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)),
    anticipation = if_else(time %in% c(19, 20, 21), 1, 0),
    intervention = if_else(time >= 22, 1, 0),
    timeafter    = if_else(time >= 21, time - 21, 0)
  )
```

# Model: Sequential model building (REML = FALSE for LRT) -----------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: itsa-model-hierarchy
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# FM_1: Basic ITSA (Bernal standard)
fm_1 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~ time + intervention + timeafter +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# FM_2: + Anticipation
fm_2 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~ time + anticipation + intervention + timeafter +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# FM_3: + Quadratic terms (maturation/ceiling effects)
fm_3 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~ time + I(time^2) + anticipation +
    intervention + timeafter + I(timeafter^2) +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# FM_4: + Region-type main effect
fm_4 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~ time + I(time^2) + anticipation +
    intervention + timeafter + I(timeafter^2) + lage_typ +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# FM_5: + Region-type × policy interactions
fm_5 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~ time + I(time^2) + anticipation +
    intervention * lage_typ + timeafter * lage_typ + I(timeafter^2) +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# FM_6: Full model (all region-type interactions)
fm_6 <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~
    time * lage_typ + I(time^2) * lage_typ + anticipation +
    intervention * lage_typ + timeafter * lage_typ + I(timeafter^2) * lage_typ +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = FALSE
)

# Final model estimated with REML
fm_final <- lmer(
  log_active_per_100k ~
    time * lage_typ + I(time^2) * lage_typ + anticipation +
    intervention * lage_typ + timeafter * lage_typ + I(timeafter^2) * lage_typ +
    (1 + time + timeafter | NUTS3),
  data = model2_data_extended, REML = TRUE
)
```

# Save model outputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: itsa-save-for-supplement
#| echo: false

library(clubSandwich)

# Model selection table
model_selection <- tibble(
  Model = c("1: Basic ITSA",
            "2: + Anticipation",
            "3: + Maturation",
            "4: + Region main effect",
            "5: + Region x Policy",
            "6: Full model"),
  Description = c(
    "Level and slope change only",
    "Adds anticipation period",
    "Adds curvilinear terms (time2, timeafter2)",
    "Adds baseline differences by urbanization",
    "Adds heterogeneous policy effects by region",
    "Full regional heterogeneity in trends"
  ),
  df     = c(extractAIC(fm_1)[1], extractAIC(fm_2)[1], extractAIC(fm_3)[1],
             extractAIC(fm_4)[1], extractAIC(fm_5)[1], extractAIC(fm_6)[1]),
  AIC    = c(AIC(fm_1), AIC(fm_2), AIC(fm_3), AIC(fm_4), AIC(fm_5), AIC(fm_6)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(fm_1), BIC(fm_2), BIC(fm_3), BIC(fm_4), BIC(fm_5), BIC(fm_6)),
  logLik = c(as.numeric(logLik(fm_1)), as.numeric(logLik(fm_2)),
             as.numeric(logLik(fm_3)), as.numeric(logLik(fm_4)),
             as.numeric(logLik(fm_5)), as.numeric(logLik(fm_6))),
  LRT_p  = c(NA,
             anova(fm_1, fm_2)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             anova(fm_2, fm_3)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             anova(fm_3, fm_4)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             anova(fm_4, fm_5)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
             anova(fm_5, fm_6)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
)

# Cluster-robust coefficient table (CR2)
itsa_coef_table <- coef_test(
  fm_final,
  vcov    = "CR2",
  cluster = model2_data_extended$NUTS3
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    Term     = Coef,
    Estimate = beta,
    SE       = SE,
    t        = tstat,
    df       = df_Satt,
    p        = p_Satt
  )

itsa_random_effects <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fm_final))

itsa_model_stats <- list(
  n_obs    = nobs(fm_final),
  n_groups = ngrps(fm_final),
  AIC      = AIC(fm_final),
  BIC      = BIC(fm_final),
  logLik   = as.numeric(logLik(fm_final))
)

dir.create(here::here("assets", "objects"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(fm_final,             here::here("assets", "objects", "fm_itsa_final.rds"))
saveRDS(model_selection,      here::here("assets", "objects", "itsa_model_selection.rds"))
saveRDS(itsa_coef_table,      here::here("assets", "objects", "itsa_coef_table.rds"))
saveRDS(itsa_random_effects,  here::here("assets", "objects", "itsa_random_effects.rds"))
saveRDS(itsa_model_stats,     here::here("assets", "objects", "itsa_model_stats.rds"))
saveRDS(model2_data_extended, here::here("assets", "objects", "model2_data_extended.rds"))
```
